description: Automated lifecycle management for Entra ID guest users. Checks all members of a given group for inactivity, disables inactive or never-logged-in accounts (unless 'report only' is set), and generates a detailed report. Robust error handling for all API calls. This workflow is scheduled to run weekly.

inputs.name: TerminateErrorMessage
inputs.value: @{concat('Graph API rate limit reached during disable operations after processing ', string(variables('TotalProcessedUsers')), ' users and disabling ', string(variables('SuccessfulDisables')), ' accounts. Please reduce batch size or run again later.')}

inputs.name: TerminateErrorMessage
inputs.value: @{concat('Disable batch operation failed with status code ', string(outputs('Execute_DisableBatch')?['statusCode']), '. ', if(equals(outputs('Execute_DisableBatch')?['statusCode'], 403), 'Permission denied - missing User.ReadWrite.All permission.', coalesce(outputs('Execute_DisableBatch')?['body']?['error']?['message'], 'Unknown error')), ' After processing ', string(variables('TotalProcessedUsers')), ' users.')}

select.reason: Still throttled or unavailable after the final retry attempt

inputs.name: ApiErrorMessage
inputs.value: @{concat('Graph API rate limit reached after processing ', string(variables('TotalProcessedUsers')), ' users. Retry-After: ', coalesce(outputs('GetUserInfosBatch')?['headers']?['Retry-After'], 'Not specified'))}

select.reason: Still throttled or unavailable after the final retry attempt

Do_Until_Process_All_Batches.expression: @or(equals(length(variables('AllMembers')), 0), equals(variables('HasRateLimit'), true), equals(variables('HasTerminateError'), true), equals(variables('HasDisableBatchError'), true))

summary.message: @if(equals(length(variables('ReportArray')),0),'No users found for deactivation.', concat(string(length(variables('ReportArray'))), ' users marked for removal'))
summary.warnings: @union(if(greater(length(variables('ThrottledUnprocessed')), 0),createArray(concat(string(length(variables('ThrottledUnprocessed'))),' request(s) were still throttled after ', string(5),' attempts and were NOT processed this run. See throttledUnprocessed.')),json('[]')),if(greater(length(variables('ItemErrors')), 0),createArray(concat(string(length(variables('ItemErrors'))),' request(s) failed with a non-retryable error. See errors.')),json('[]')))
